menuItems.name: Crispy Calamari
menuItems.description: Tender calamari rings lightly breaded and fried to golden perfection, served with house-made marinara and lemon aioli.
menuItems.chefNote: Our most popular starter - pairs perfectly with a crisp white wine.

menuItems.name: Burrata & Heirloom Tomatoes
menuItems.description: Naturally gluten-free creamy imported burrata cheese served over vine-ripened heirloom tomatoes with fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, and aged balsamic reduction.
menuItems.chefNote: Best enjoyed in summer when tomatoes are at peak ripeness.

menuItems.name: Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps
menuItems.description: Gluten-free spiced minced chicken with water chestnuts, ginger, and Thai chilies served in crisp butter lettuce cups with peanut sauce.

menuItems.name: Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
menuItems.description: Gluten-free oven-roasted golden and red beets with creamy goat cheese, candied walnuts, arugula, and honey-citrus vinaigrette.

menuItems.name: Classic Caesar Salad
menuItems.description: Crisp romaine hearts tossed in our house-made Caesar dressing with shaved Parmesan and garlic croutons.
menuItems.chefNote: Add grilled chicken (+$6) or salmon (+$9) to make it a main.

menuItems.name: Pan-Seared Duck Breast
menuItems.description: Gluten-free perfectly rendered duck breast with crispy skin, served over wild mushroom risotto with a cherry port reduction.
menuItems.chefNote: Our signature dish - cooked medium-rare for optimal tenderness.

menuItems.name: Grilled Ribeye Steak
menuItems.description: Gluten-free 16oz USDA Prime ribeye, dry-aged 28 days, grilled to your preference. Served with roasted seasonal vegetables and your choice of sauce.
ingredients: choice of: peppercorn sauce, béarnaise, chimichurri
menuItems.chefNote: Ask your server about our dry-aging process.

menuItems.name: Herb-Crusted Salmon
menuItems.description: Gluten-free Atlantic salmon fillet with a Dijon-herb crust, served over lemon quinoa with grilled asparagus and dill cream sauce.

menuItems.name: Lobster Risotto
menuItems.description: Gluten-free creamy Arborio rice cooked with lobster stock, finished with butter-poached Maine lobster tail, mascarpone, and fresh chives.
menuItems.chefNote: A guest favorite for special occasions.

menuItems.name: Grilled Portobello Stack
menuItems.description: Marinated portobello mushroom cap stacked with roasted red peppers, caramelized onions, and herbed goat cheese on a brioche bun.
menuItems.chefNote: Can be made vegan without cheese and on gluten-free bread.

menuItems.name: Thai Red Curry Vegetables
menuItems.description: Gluten-free seasonal vegetables simmered in aromatic red curry coconut milk, served with jasmine rice and crispy shallots.
menuItems.chefNote: Spice level can be adjusted - ask your server.

menuItems.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
menuItems.description: House-made spaghetti tossed with crispy guanciale, egg yolk, Pecorino Romano, and fresh cracked black pepper.

menuItems.name: Wild Mushroom Fettuccine
menuItems.description: Fresh fettuccine with a medley of wild mushrooms, truffle cream sauce, and shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano.
menuItems.chefNote: Made with seasonal foraged mushrooms when available.

menuItems.name: Truffle Parmesan Fries
menuItems.description: Gluten-free crispy hand-cut fries tossed with white truffle oil, grated Parmesan, and fresh herbs.

menuItems.name: Grilled Broccolini
menuItems.description: Gluten-free tender broccolini charred on the grill with garlic, lemon zest, and chili flakes.

menuItems.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
menuItems.description: Warm dark chocolate cake with a molten center, served with vanilla bean ice cream and fresh berries.
menuItems.chefNote: Allow 15 minutes preparation time - worth the wait!

menuItems.name: Crème Brûlée
menuItems.description: Gluten-free classic vanilla bean custard with a caramelized sugar crust, served with fresh seasonal berries.

menuItems.name: Vegan Coconut Panna Cotta
menuItems.description: Gluten-free silky coconut milk panna cotta topped with mango coulis and toasted coconut flakes.
menuItems.chefNote: Our most popular dairy-free dessert option.

menuItems.name: House Cabernet Sauvignon
menuItems.description: Gluten-free full-bodied California Cabernet with notes of black cherry, cassis, and vanilla oak.

menuItems.name: Sonoma Chardonnay
menuItems.description: Gluten-free elegant Chardonnay with bright citrus, green apple, and subtle oak undertones.

menuItems.name: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade
menuItems.description: Gluten-free house-made lemonade with fresh lemons and a hint of mint.

menuItems.name: Thai Iced Tea
menuItems.description: Gluten-free traditional Thai black tea with sweetened condensed milk, served over ice.
